Kofi (Customer Success): Heads-up: Invoice 5278 for NovaCare failed a scheduled card run this morning. Stripe returned decline `do_not_honor`. Customer needs access today and asked for alternatives - can we retry or accept wire/ACH?

billing-bot: [payment.failed] invoice=5278 customer=NovaCare provider=Stripe code=do_not_honor id=pi_7Ab...

Eve (Finance): We can do one manual retry now. Also offer Plaid ACH link or wire. If their bank blocks micro-deposits (common on business savings), ask for bank letter or outbound wire confirmation.

Miles (Ops): FYI don't run retries within 10m of a decline or gateway may flag. I can schedule a manual retry ~15m out if you want confirmation today.

Leah (Sales): Please hold provisioning until payment or wire confirmation is posted. If they wire today we can waive the expedited fee.

Kofi (Customer Success): Billing contact is payables@novacare.co. They tried Plaid and got "unsupported account type" (business savings). They said they'll initiate a same-day wire and will send the bank confirmation screenshot.

Eve (Finance): Wire instructions (send via secure channel only):

```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: First National Bank of Redwood
ACH Routing: 061000104
Account #: 987654321
SWIFT: FNBUS33
Reference: INVOICE 5278 / NovaCare
```

Eve (Finance): When they forward the outbound confirmation (PDF or SWIFT copy) we'll mark invoice 5278 as paid pending settlement in QuickBooks and suppress auto-reminders.

Kofi (Customer Success): Sent secure wire template to payables@novacare.co. They replied they'll wire within 2 hours and will post the confirmation here when done. Will update this thread with the screenshot.

Miles (Ops): Copy. I'll stand by to trigger provisioning once finance marks the invoice paid pending settlement.

Leah (Sales): Thanks everyone. Hoping for the confirmation so we can unblock onboarding today. :crossed_fingers:
